latHint: Think the lone item that always goes missing in the dryer.
pivHint: A garden HOSE waters the plants - but long ago HOSE also meant the ______ you pull on before shoes.
winText: Well covered. HOSE was the pivot - a watering tube to old-fashioned SOCKS.
lossText: SOCKS - coverings for the feet. HOSE was the pivot: a garden HOSE, and the old word HOSE for leg and foot coverings.
